dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular elliptical and figure-eight rings along the lateral line with high-contrast transitions from dark outer perimeters to lighter grey/white interiors; edges exhibit jagged geometry and varying thickness.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High concentration of small, high-intensity pixel clusters in the anterior neck area; lower spatial density of solid light blobs interspersed between macro-annuli along the mid-dorsal ridge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Three prominent mid-body macro-annuli centroids form a wide-angled obtuse triangle; a secondary linear sequence of smaller annuli extends towards the posterior.

other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, high-intensity V-shaped mark is visible on the lateral surface of the neck area.
